description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository.

branch.description: Branch on which to create or update the file.

message.description: Commit message for the file change.

owner.description: Owner of the repository (user or organization name).

path.description: Path where the file will be created or updated, relative to the repository root.

sha.description: SHA of the existing file being replaced. Required when updating an existing file; omit when creating a new file.

name: create_or_update_file
